ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 8:1 ratio of high-intensity white/cream pixels to low-intensity black boundary pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white central region; black perimeter banding extending along the trailing edge to the tips; low-intensity yellowish-brown pigment clusters in the lower central and lower-right quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped indentation with an approximate 82-degree interior angle and a depth of roughly 150 vertical pixel units relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the continuous trailing edge; higher amplitude jaggedness observed on the distal left lobe boundary compared to the right.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced convex upward sweep of the distal lobe margins tapering to acute lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white/grey pixel clusters (barnacles) concentrated on the lateral tips of both lobes; secondary scattered dark-pixel focal points on the mid-left ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle colonization on distal lobe tips; diffuse yellowish-brown bio-staining on the lower third of the ventral fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetric yellowish-brown surface staining primarily concentrated on the lower-right fluke lobe.
